page: Amazon Web Services m8idn.48xlarge is an eighth-generation general purpose instance designed to support enterprise-scale compute, data, and throughput demands. Built on the AWS Nitro hypervisor, the platform operates on Intel x86_64 processors running at 3.9 GHz. The instance provisions 96 physical cores across 192 dedicated vCPUs with hyper-threading enabled. System memory totals 768.0 GB, providing an even 4.0 GB of memory per core to maintain a standard 1:4 compute-to-memory ratio across the entire footprint.

A key differentiator of the m8idn.48xlarge configuration is its bundled local storage and expansive network pipeline. The instance includes 11,400 GB of integrated local NVMe SSD instance storage, enabling high-throughput and low-latency physical disk operations. Its baseline networking throughput reaches 300 Gbps, accommodating extreme bandwidth requirements without external network bottlenecks. The primary architectural tradeoff centers on scale and data persistence; while the instance offers extreme compute density and throughput efficiency on a single physical host, the attached NVMe storage is ephemeral and requires distributed replication strategies for critical state.

This hardware profile delivers cost efficiency through resource consolidation, allowing organizations to run large-scale aggregated operations on one instance rather than managing multiple smaller virtual machines. The m8idn.48xlarge is engineered for high-concurrency relational and NoSQL databases, in-memory data processing, large distributed caching layers, intensive extract-transform-load (ETL) data pipelines, and high-throughput web serving architectures that require significant local temporary storage.
description: Amazon Web Services m8idn.48xlarge is an eighth-generation general purpose cloud instance configured for high-throughput, resource-intensive enterprise workloads. Powered by the AWS Nitro System and Intel x86_64 architecture, this instance supplies 96 physical cores and 192 dedicated vCPUs clocked at 3.9 GHz, paired with 768.0 GB of system memory at a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio. Built-in storage includes 11,400 GB of fast local NVMe SSD capacity, providing direct low-latency disk I/O without relying solely on external network volumes. Network capacity is anchored by a 300 Gbps baseline network throughput, enabling high-volume distributed communication. By consolidating substantial core counts, expansive memory, dense instance storage, and enterprise networking onto a single host footprint, the instance delivers high compute and data consolidation efficiency. The hardware profile is engineered for demanding applications including large-scale distributed databases, extensive analytics pipelines, enterprise resource planning systems, high-traffic web applications, and compute-heavy container clusters requiring substantial local scratch storage.
